hypotheses.threshold: The clean-calibrated gate withholds usable estimates. At least one fixed quality policy meets the limits in every test stratum.
hypotheses.reconstruction: Beat reconstruction is a material constraint. Removing IMU beat exclusion changes paired error by at least five percentage points in one or more strata.
hypotheses.compound_fault: Compound contact and motion faults change availability. Compare availability at identical scheduled times and seeds with motion alone.
